title: 巨型城市伙伴
prompt: Use case: identity-preserving production-master stability validation. Create one vertical 9:16 image composed for an exact final size of 720x1280 pixels from exactly two input images. Image 1 is a proposed self-owned runtime master copied byte-for-byte from an approved public preview. It is the sole reference for composition, scene, pose, expression, styling, lighting, palette, clothing, props and text layout. Image 2 is the sole pet identity reference. Replace every animal depiction in Image 1 with the exact cream long-haired cat from Image 2. Preserve the target pet's pale cream long coat, soft cream points, blue eyes, pink nose, triangular ears, fluffy tail and full natural proportions. Image 2 controls identity and species; do not retain the sample animal's breed or facial structure from Image 1. The replacement must remain recognisably the same cat as Image 2 while naturally adopting Image 1's pose and expression. Preserve its real age and breed proportions; do not beautify, juvenilize, enlarge or shrink the head arbitrarily, or invent a generic cute face. Scene-change budget: 0%. Do not redesign, simplify, crop, recolour, relight, add, remove or move any background element, garment, prop, graphic mark or text. Make only the smallest local geometry adjustment needed for the replacement animal to fit the existing pose and clothing. Keep the monumental pet scale among skyscrapers and traffic. Both eyes must stay directed downward toward the tiny people and cars, never toward the camera. Keep all existing readable text unchanged. Add no new text, logo, signature, watermark or AI label. Avoid duplicate heads, extra eyes, extra ears, extra limbs, malformed paws, fused clothing, floating props and mixed-species anatomy.
